g.text: Universal PPO Policy V3 — Observations, Actions, Rewards, Nominal Backends, and Variant Roadmap

g.title: taxonomy
g.text: Nominal ID–FD backend — current V3 workflow
Nominal command-ROM backend — current V3 workflow
Nominal ROM policy fine-tuned with online AAM estimates — implemented
Upper-bound diagnostic with AAM — future, not deployment

g.title: actor
g.text: PPO clipped objective + GAE; γ = 0.99, λ = 0.95

g.title: obs
g.text: tool error, measured velocity, reference velocity, reference acceleration
four cylinder extensions, goal errors, and velocities
four valve commands and four backend extension increments
direction, relative clearance, head alignment, alignment rate
No shape label and no vehicle command

g.title: action
g.text: PPO never commands wheels, parking, or station transitions

g.title: backend
g.text: Measure tool pose/velocity, cylinders, valve, backend increment, clearance, head alignment
V3 is the chosen main workflow for both nominal A pipelines

g.title: reward
g.text: − quadratic tracking guard − measured tool acceleration
− head deviation − clearance deviation − valve saturation
Promote only if mean/p95 error improve and acceleration, completion, alignment, drift remain safe

g.title: supervisor
g.text: PPO enabled only in ARM_TRACK; truck locked during tool work
